title: {Syn} AlphaZero Learned Games From Self-Play
content:
AlphaZero learned chess, shogi, and Go through self-play using the game rules, neural networks, and search. It did not need human game records as training examples.

The result made self-play feel like a general recipe for domains where simulators and clear win conditions are available.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
